description: Apply an implementation action to a memo. Supports text_replace (requires occurrence or replaceAll when oldText has multiple matches; optional section-scoped propagation), file_patch (applies unified diff patch — snapshot saved first), and file_create (create a new file). Creates a snapshot before modification, records the implementation, and updates memo status to needs_review.

content.description: For file_create: the file content to write

dryRun.description: If true, return preview without writing

file.description: Path to the annotated markdown file

memoId.description: The memo ID to apply implementation to

occurrence.description: For text_replace: which occurrence to replace (1-indexed). Required when oldText appears multiple times unless replaceAll=true

oldText.description: For text_replace: the text to find and replace

patch.description: For file_patch: unified diff patch content

replaceAll.description: For text_replace: replace all occurrences instead of one

scope.description: For text_replace: replacement scope (body = whole document body, section = heading section around memo anchor)

name: apply_memo
